debugData.name: Showcase bunker
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's bunker and wall segment on the wetlands' pad (p310 §3.6; devTools/blender/buildShowcaseBlocks.py, from the add-on's structure_concrete.blend): a 6 × 4 × 2.6 m bunker with a doorway and a 12 m wall, no UVs (the structure material is triplanar), their wear in COLOR_0 (RGBA), and box colliders as child nodes (CUBOID, a FIXED compound body each: index 0 the bunker, 1 the wall).
